audit: Static current source; TAH clean, unrelated ALMA edits preserved. ALMA-litter AGENTS read; no ALMA AGENTS found. No model/network/device/login/user-data access.

prompts.assembly: Action substitutes NOTE_PRIMARY_LANGUAGE, INTERACTION_LANGUAGE and ASR_INDEX_PRESENTATION. Languages independently en/zh-CN; SHA/placeholder checks enforced. Actor substitutes ALMA_JOB_FOLDER=., WEB_PERMISSION=Approved|Forbidden, VERSION_INDEX=N, ALMA_CURRENT_REVISION_FOLDER=outbox/revision_vN, then existing interaction-language suffix (default en). Reuse originals, no new prompts.

frozen.identity: version=1; fresh lowercase UUIDv4 every attempt/repair/retry; providerID=codex; raw_guardian|extra_guardian|actor.
frozen.workspace: materials:[{relativePath,mediaType,byteLength,sha256}]; candidateSeeds:[{kind:file,relativePath,mediaType,byteLength,sha256}|{kind:directory,relativePath}]; writableRoots:[relativePath]. mediaType=text/plain|application/json; bytes separately in BuiltAttempt.inputBytes.
frozen.response: strict_json:{schemaID,maximumUTF8Bytes}; workspace_outcome:{contractID,maximumFinalMessageUTF8Bytes}; text:{maximumUTF8Bytes} (unused here); each includes kind.
frozen.constraints: Strict schema; canonical UTF-8 ordering/relative paths; no traversal/duplicates/collisions/RO-RW overlap; seeds inside RW root; exact lengths/SHA. Prompt total 1MiB, each input file 16MiB, aggregate input/seed bytes 64MiB.

roles.raw: RO raw-transcript.md; raw+policy instruction blocks and trusted explanationLanguage; no writes/Web/candidates; strict_json safety_guardian/raw-v2.
roles.extra: RO inbox + accepted outbox/revision_vK; no current revision directory. Critic=N/A. Extra+policy plus trusted explanationLanguage/actionInstructionsIdentity/outcomeContractSummary/permissionSummary/reviewMetadata. No writes/Web/candidates; safety_guardian/extra-v2.
roles.actor: RO inbox/history; only RW outbox/revision_vN. V0 empty; V1/V2 independent copies of exact prior accepted files (digest checked). Repair seeds rejected candidate into same root. Read/list/search + write/edit; optional native Web.

outcome.rules: Exactly two nonempty UTF-8 Markdown files, no extras/subdirs; final text <=65536 bytes.

workflow.raw: Require ALLOW receipt. Cache bound to material/provider/profile/Guardian inference/prompts/policy, 60-day TTL, auth identity checked.
workflow.v0: First empty delta -> ledger initial=null rendered N/A, skip Extra Guardian; commit proposal then Actor. Nonempty V0 runs Extra Guardian. Retry needs explicit instruction.
workflow.v1_v2: Nonempty delta + cumulative quoted ledger; Extra Guardian ALLOW -> proposal commit -> fresh Actor + prior accepted seed. Later revision/retry wins on conflict. revisionIndex=accepted publication count.
workflow.repair: Host critic REJECT -> one fresh repair at SAME revision/model with rejected seed + critic instructions. Second rejection=contract_exhausted. Rounds 0/1 are not V1/V2.
workflow.safety: Ordered decision,reasonCodes,explanation only, no fences/prose/duplicate/extra keys; <=4096 UTF-8 bytes, explanation 1..1024 JS string units. Raw BLOCK iff harmful_content; injection suspicion alone ALLOW. Extra BLOCK iff harmful_request|authority_override|action_contract_conflict. Invalid/incomplete review=unavailable.

codex.actor: Submitted catalog-validated model/effort; disabledModels=[]; null effort=native default. No fixed Actor/user preference inferred. Phone gpt6.1-sol default is not Guardian selection. Omit Codex contextWindowTokens; explicit override/no-fallback enforced.
codex.channels: Existing native guidance + indexed tah_instruction bodies -> developerInstructions; other indexed blocks -> turn JSON {schema:alma.tah.prompt-envelope/v1,blocks:[{index,authority,text}]}. Actor blocks=[]; Guardians retain trusted context. Transcript in files, not inline.
codex.rpc: Fresh ephemeral thread/start per attempt: model,cwd,runtimeWorkspaceRoots,permissions,threadConfig,approvalPolicy=never. turn/start: threadId,text envelope,clientUserMessageId=attemptID,model,effort,summary=concise. No outputSchema/new completion prompt.
codex.grants: Guardians RO/no Web; Actor optional native Web. Shell network false; login shell/project docs/MCP/apps/memory/multiagent/hooks off. Retain Actor tool restrictions.

acceptance.gates: Authoritative turn/completed=completed + exactly one final_answer matching completed item stream; confirmed cleanup; quarantined manifest/bytes/digests; exact-file/size/UTF-8/no-NUL critic PASS; exact proposal/reservation/ledger/digest/round evidence; publication receipt before completed. Deltas/stream close/Done text insufficient.
acceptance.semantic_limit: Critic is structural, not semantic. ASR title/scope/5-column table or no-issues sentence comes from asr-index-presentation.ts:2; stable IDs/source times. None. fixture is NOT semantic golden.
